name: 60660 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60660 (Chicago) has 186 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60660 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
